comment: Lockfile of all runtime profiles and their resource packs (one per Minecraft version, OpenGL renderer optimised by Sodium). URLs and SHA-512 hashes were taken from the official Modrinth API (api.modrinth.com/v2) on 2026-10-15 (26.1.2), 2026-10-18 (1.21.11, 1.21.8) and 2026-10-19 (all other versions; 1.8.9 and 1.12.2 run on Legacy Fabric with its own API and ViaFabric, there is no Sodium for them). Only profiles with a lumora-client artifact include the Lumora companion mod. Third-party mods are never bundled; the launcher downloads them from the Modrinth CDN and verifies every byte against these hashes. 'key' groups the per-version builds of the same mod (extension toggles are stored by key). Fresh Food is not in the 1.21.11 profile: its shader overlay for formats 65-75 fails to link there (Minecraft then drops all resource packs).
